context: These are one‑time, in‑party topical greetings that trigger when the group notices a devil apparently tailing them; Astarion interprets the creature’s behavior as deliberate manipulation rather than coincidence. His lines draw on a traumatic history with his former master Cazador—who also "played" with victims—which can shift the tone into dark memory or bitter exasperation. Player replies (bravado, dismissal, or firm resolve) steer his reaction toward irritation, sombre recollection, or cautious agreement. Note: these nodes are part of Astarion’s wandering/in‑party dialog and early in the game players may not yet be aware of his vampiric nature.
